pages.en:
636
C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 636
Date 9/10/16
Shanghai Municipal Council.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)
7th October 1916.

Sir,
From the evening of the 8th inst everyone passing
along the roads near the Arsenal after 10 p.m. will
be searched.

General Lu of Woosung who has not visited his
superior General Yang for a month, arrived at Headquarters
yesterday and was closeted with General Yang for four
hours.

The troops were paid on the 6th inst.

On the 10th inst General Yang proposes to review all
the troops under his command on a piece of ground near
the Shanghai Hangchow Railway Station.

It is reported that General Yang has granted an
advance of a sum of money to the Rebel leaders for
distribution among the destitute rebels.

On the 6th inst the City Magistrate sent for the
representatives of the master painters with a view to
effecting a solution of the present deadlock.

Your obedient servant,

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.
pages.zh:
636
刑事侦缉处
情报官登记
第 636 号
日期 1916年10月9日
上海工部局。
（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探科。）
1916年10月7日。

先生，
自本月8日晚起，凡晚上10时后经过兵工厂附近道路者，均将接受搜查。

驻吴淞的卢将军已有一个月未去拜见其上级杨将军，他于昨日抵达总部，并与杨将军密谈四小时。

部队已于本月6日发饷。

据悉，杨将军拟于本月10日在上海杭州火车站附近的一块空地上检阅其麾下所有部队。

有报告称，杨将军已向叛军首领预支一笔款项，用于分发给贫困的叛军士兵。

本月6日，上海县知事传讯画师行会的代表，以期解决目前的僵局。

您顺从的仆人，

首席侦探督察。

警务处总监警司。
